endpoint: 100*(sample SD bilinear/sample SD matched drop - 1), all paired valid windows, fixed trained Gaussian widths
starResampling: Stars sampled with replacement within each tile, preserving all their valid windows and shared draws across methods, apertures, calibrations and parities.
regionResampling: Sample nine tiles with replacement 10000 times, preserving original window weights. Also omit each tile once.
decision: Stable direction requires both percentile intervals and every leave-one-tile estimate strictly on the same side of zero. Compare the four stable M8 M20 contrasts by exact parity, aperture, drop and calibration label.
scope: Independent IC 1805 field and camera. Registration outside tolerance and no matched dark flats. Descriptive exploratory transfer, no native admission or scientific closure.
